svg.title: SVAES, automated release validation. Bachelor's thesis graded 10/10. Python, FastAPI, Rust, Angular, PostgreSQL, Docker.
svg.text: A multi-tenant quality gate that verifies the coherence, integrity and completeness of
software releases in CI/CD pipelines. Hexagonal architecture, role-based access, JWT
and twenty connectors, among them Jira, GitHub and Confluence. FastAPI backend,
Angular frontend and a verification engine in Rust.
Python, FastAPI, Rust, Angular, PostgreSQL, Docker
